notes: New: **passes for compositing**: metric depth (`depth.Z`, metres, steady over the shot), camera-space normals (`N.x/y/z`), motion vectors (`forward.u/v`, `backward.u/v`), clip / synth masks. One choice on the main screen: *HDR*, *HDR + comp passes* or *Custom*. The models are added in Components when needed.

New: **hero matte** (`matte.A`): a soft alpha of the shot's main subject - hair, glow, smoke included - from Lightricks' Alpha Gen IC-LoRA on the same LTX-2.5 model. The model picks the subject. Optional component (1.2 GB); the LTX-2.5 text encoder (14 GB) is needed once and can be removed afterwards.

New: **recover crushed shadows** (on by default): where the source is crushed to black the detail comes from LTX at the source's local exposure; everything brighter than code 25 stays the source bit for bit.

New: **8-bit clean-up**. For 8-bit sources the steps between codes are filled before the HDR, every value within half a code of the source (re-quantised it is the source exactly): the HDR's shadows come out about a third closer to a 10-bit original, motion vectors 15 % closer. 10-bit and higher sources are never touched. Advanced → on/off.

New: **source check** when a video is added (bit depth, chroma, frame rate, colour tags, duplicates, soft or upscaled footage) and a **quality check** after the conversion (exposure, colour, seams, flicker) under the timeline.

New: **output layout**: *One EXR* (every layer in one file a frame, as in 0.1) or *Folder per layer* (`hdr/`, `depth/`, `normals/`, `vectors/`, `matte/`, `clip/`, `synth/`, files `<name>_<layer>_1001.exr`, the same channel names).

Weaker machines: HDR first, then passes and the hero matte, with progress for every long step; a busy video card (a browser on an 8 GB card) slows a step down instead of pausing it forever; the disk is checked before the GPU work starts; closing the window during a conversion stops it cleanly and gives the memory back.

Re-runs are fast: finished steps (HDR chunks, passes, hero matte) are kept in the work folder next to the app and reused for the same source and settings; the status says what was reused. A change of seed, model or input transform computes the HDR again. Advanced → *Compute everything again* empties a shot's work folder first.
